title: asperula glomerata var. capitata
intro: Asperula glomerata var. capitata, commonly known as woodruff, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Asperula glomerata var. capitata include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
